entries.zh: 摇桨，划船（楫：船桨、橹；指划动舢舨小船）
entries.en: to row, to paddle (a champán/sampan); oar, scull
entries.notes: M 栏声调号 T99 污损难辨；语义据 L remar champan（舢舨/唐船）与 H 楫互证仍明。

entries.zh: 划小艇，摇桨（banca：小舟、独木舟）
entries.en: to row a banca (small boat, dugout canoe); to paddle
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:抜杭/抌杭]未定，释义以西语词头 remar banca（banca：小艇）为主轴推定。

entries.en: to correct, to amend; to fix, to change
to protect, to shield; to guard, to defend
to urge, to persuade; to exhort, to encourage

entries.zh: 周旋，应酬；交际，与人周旋
entries.en: to socialize with, to mix with; to deal with, to cope with

entries.zh: 支持，扶持；支应，助成其事
entries.en: to support, to back up; to sustain, to help along some affair
to mend, to patch; to repair, to fill in

entries.zh: 缝补，补缀；搭补遮盖（tapar：遮盖、填补）
entries.en: to mend, to patch; to cover over, to plug
entries.notes: 第二汉字[疑:苫/荅]，据 M 栏 pou tâ（補搭）与西语 tapar 推定为搭补之义。

entries.zh: 申呈，申报；申述，陈明（呈于上司）
entries.en: to report up to a superior; to state, to set forth

entries.zh: 解送，押解（解送上司）；解（解释、解说）
entries.en: to remit up to a superior; to escort (persons, silver) under guard; to explain

entries.zh: 批行到县，上司批文下县衙；批（批答、批饬）
entries.en: to issue an endorsed directive down to the county; to endorse (a report) with instructions
entries.notes: 批縣本为下行批文之义，与本行连排词头 remitir a el superior（呈上）方向相牾，疑词头未逐条更换。

entries.zh: 申文书，呈文（呈送上司的公文）
entries.en: report document submitted to a superior; official report

entries.zh: 申详，详报（详文呈请上司裁夺）
entries.en: to report in detail to a superior; detailed report for decision
to issue, to send official documents; official correspondence
entries.notes: M 栏首字声调号 T99 污损；L 栏 aelsupor 为 a el superior 连写，语义据 H 行文书仍明。

entries.zh: 行文至府，发文到府衙；行（下行公文）
entries.en: to send official documents to the prefecture office
entries.notes: M 栏首字声调号 T99 污损；语义据 H 行府与 L remitir a el superior 推定。

entries.zh: 批行到府，批文下发府衙；批复
entries.en: to endorse and remit down to the prefecture; written directive to a subordinate office
